narrative:
## Handover Summary — Exploration, Development & Renewables CapEx

Capex validated by program with depreciation profiles.

## Key Decisions
• Al-Rimal phase 3 facilities kept in FY2026 (USD 3.2B)
• USD 5–8B of gas expansion capex identified that could move to FY2027 if Brent falls below USD 60
• Ras Meridian conversion project funding confirmed

## Recommendation for Consolidation
Test the dividend funding gap at USD 60 Brent before the board submission.

signals.title: Dividend exceeds free cash flow
signals.excerpt: The FY2026 budget dividend of $83.7B exceeds free cash flow of $60.3B after $51.2B capex; the $23B gap is funded from cash and debt and widens to about $35B at $60 Brent.
